title: MTech Project
standfirst: A year-long research or engineering project taken end-to-end, supervised, and defended in a viva.
syllabus_body_html:
A project in the broad area of machine learning and AI, completed after finishing the PG Diploma core courses.

Credits: 20

How the project runs:

  • The project will be in the broad area of machine learning and AI.
  • It could be done in a company or a research lab.
  • It will be executed and evaluated similarly to web MTech programs.
  • Students can start the project after completing the core courses of the PG Diploma.
